title: Roblox reports Q3 bookings down 12% YoY to $1.7B, vs. $1.63B est., and DAUs down 9% to 138M, vs. 145.8M est.; RBLX drops 16%+ after hours (Cecilia D'Anastasio/Bloomberg)
summary: Cecilia D'Anastasio / Bloomberg: Roblox reports Q3 bookings down 12% YoY to $1.7B, vs. $1.63B est., and DAUs down 9% to 138M, vs. 145.8M est.; RBLX drops 16%+ after hours — Roblox Corp. reported a year-over-year decline in player engagement after deploying more robust child-safety measures.
